technical_quality: Adequate: good inspiration, no significant rotation, well penetrated; L marker in the upper right corner of the image confirms conventional orientation. Slight neck flexion; costophrenic angles included.

devices.type: Radiographic side marker (L) with technologist initials
devices.location: Upper right corner of the image, projected lateral to the patient's left shoulder / acromioclavicular region

devices.type: Multiple small linear metallic foreign bodies (probable retained acupuncture-needle fragments / gold-thread implants)
devices.location: Soft tissues of the right lower neck / supraclavicular region, lateral to the cervical spine, above the right clavicle

abnormalities.finding: Well-circumscribed round solid nodule, about 2 cm, no visible calcification or cavitation, partly overlapped by an anterior rib; sits above the aortic knob at about the level of the 2nd anterior rib (upper/middle zone junction)

description_zh: PA 胸部正面片，吸氣充分、無明顯旋轉，L 標記位於影像右上角，符合常規擺位。左上肺野（主動脈弓上方、約第 2 前肋高度）可見一顆邊緣清楚的圓形結節狀陰影，直徑約 2 公分，內部未見明顯鈣化或空洞，部分與前肋重疊。右肺野清晰，雙側肋膈角銳利，心臟大小及縱膈輪廓正常，未見肋膜積液、氣胸或肺門腫大。另於右側下頸部軟組織內見多枚細小線狀金屬密度影，疑為殘留針灸針或埋線異物；未見胸管、引流管或其他治療相關裝置。
